reviews.title: Hug in a mug!
reviews.body: As someone who enjoys a simple cup of tea without diving too deep into the complexities of flavors and brewing techniques, I was pleasantly surprised by Fun Harness and Son's Spicy Cinnamon Tea. Here's my take on it:The moment you open the packet, you're greeted with a warm, inviting scent of cinnamon. It's not overwhelming but enough to make you eager to brew a cup.The tea strikes a good balance between spice and sweetness. The cinnamon is prominent but not overpowering, giving the tea a cozy, warming quality. It reminds me a bit of the flavor of a cinnamon roll, which is delightful.It's a medium-bodied tea, which means it doesn't feel too heavy or too light. It's just right for a comforting drink when winding down for bed.Brewing is smple and straightforward. Just steep a bag in hot water for a few minutes, and you're good to go. No need for any fancy equipment or precise timing.This tea feels like a hug in a mug. It's perfect for those chilly days when you need something to warm you up. As someone who isn't a tea connoisseur, I appreciate that it's flavorful without being complicated. If you're looking for an easy-to-enjoy tea with a nice kick of cinnamon, this one is definitely worth it!

reviews.body: If you like cinnamon you'll love this! Nice strong cinnamon smell and incredible flavor. Has a natural sweetness to it, without any sugar! Love that you can get it decaffeinated. I enjoy sipping it on cold evenings before bed. Harney and Sons is known for high quality teas, and this one is my favorite.

reviews.title: Great to use for hot toddies
reviews.body: Harney and Son’s hot cinnamon is one of my favorite teas, especially on those cold evenings. I also like to use the decaf tea so that it doesn’t keep me up at night. I particularly love to use the hot cinnamon tea to make hot toddy’s if I have a sore throat it’s the perfect tea to use. I’ve made them for others and they say it’s the best hot toddy they’ve ever had.

reviews.title: Lovely flavor for a cold winter!
reviews.body: I’m a huge fan of this tea. It was a good find. It’s got a lot of flavor. I sometimes add a ginger tea bag to the cup as well. It’s been great through a harsh New England winter this year. I’ve been buying this tea for about 4-5 years now. I drink it black. It’s worth every penny!

features: DECAF HOT CINNAMON SPICE TEA – Decaffeinated Ceylon black tea blended with three types of cinnamon, orange peel, and cloves.
CINNAMON & SPICE FLAVOR – Decaffeinated Ceylon black tea with three types of cinnamon, orange peel, and cloves. Enjoy hot or over ice.
50 WHOLE LEAF TEA SACHETS – Resealable bag contains 50 whole leaf sachets. Each sachet brews one 12 oz. cup or two 6 oz. cups of tea.
DECAFFEINATED BLACK TEA – Decaffeinated Ceylon black tea blended with cinnamon, orange peel, and cloves.

A TRADITION OF TEA DISCOVERY – For more than 40 years, the Harney family has explored the world's great tea regions in search of exceptional teas and distinctive blends. As a proud member of 1% for the Planet, Harney & Sons donates 1% of all sales to environmental nonprofits working to protect and restore our planet.
